subject: Film & Cinema
title: Japanese Golden Age: Kurosawa and Ozu
description: One-minute skill: Japanese Golden Age: Kurosawa and Ozu.

hook.text: Two Japanese directors offered opposite visions — and both changed world cinema.

buildup.text: Kurosawa made epic samurai dramas with dynamic movement. Ozu filmed still domestic scenes.

discovery.text: Kurosawa influenced action cinema globally. Ozu influenced art cinema's patient, quiet gaze.

twist.text: Ozu was barely known outside Japan for decades, while Kurosawa was celebrated worldwide.

climax.text: Together, they proved Japanese cinema could be universal in two completely different ways.

punchline.text: One moved the camera. One kept it still. Both mastered cinema.

quiz.question: How did Kurosawa and Ozu differ as filmmakers?
options: Kurosawa was dynamic and epic; Ozu was still and intimate
